events.title: Daily Mode and Seven New Languages Are Officially Live!
events.summary: A massive thank you to everyone who has played the Bowl Big demo since our launch! Seeing the game pass 1 million gameplay views on YouTube has been completely surreal.To celebrate and keep the momentum going, we’ve just pushed a major update to the free Steam demo. events.title: Bowl Big with An Event About Incrementals!
events.summary: Hi! We’re excited to be a part of An Event About Incrementals organized by Catoptric Games, Lazy Otter and Next in Game to celebrate incremental games from October 8-22. As part of the festival, we’ll be launching an updated demo with new features this weekend. Stay tuned!

events.title: BOWL BIG DEMO PATCH NOTES VERSION 1.2

Added a speed combo multiplier to the alley bowler mini game.Improved visuals of the lanes by adding more lanes and adding a more cohesive lane divider.Slight balancing changes to values in the tech treeChanged order of a popup hint to make controls more concise

events.title: BOWL BIG DEMO PATCH NOTES VERSION 1.1
events.summary: BOWL BIG DEMO PATCH NOTES VERSION 1.1Made transition between bowls smooth rather than teleporting back to the throw positionAdded one more row of pins for purchase in the tech treeAdded a Go Bowling button in the tech treeMade it so you can continue blowing infinity till you score your first pin at the start of the gameMade the Goal number to reach in intro larger/more visibleFixed imposible to get arcade coins spawnChanged Intro controls text to be more clearFixed Tutorial popup being too close

events.title: The Bowl Big Demo is LIVE! Go from One Pin to Quadrillions of Points TODAY!
events.summary: Bowling has been exactly the same for over 500 years. We decided to change that.Forget standard ten-pin limits. Bowl Big takes the sport you know and injects it with pure, chaotic, exponential scaling. The playable Steam demo is officially live right now, and we are incredibly hyped that Bowl Big has been selected for The Best Indie Games Fall Showcase 2026!What is Bowl Big?You start small on a basic lane, but every single throw earns you points to unlock a deep, tech tree.
